english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something beneath the water surface or underwater.
Use this specifically for underwater conditions or equipment, whether in seawater or freshwater.

examples.english: We took a glass-bottom boat to see the undersea world.
This marine camera still works after being submerged for so long.
examples.traditional: 水底攝影機浸咗咁耐都仲用得。
